text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You know, something to lift the spirits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've been lacking sufficient stimulation in
my
everyday routine. I feel like my brain
cells are
about to begin dying off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even coming up to this rooftop to
observe the
activities of Umamusume has
failed to get me
going...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... It would be interesting, maybe, if

someone like... tripled in size or
something...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon seems to be suffering
from the
boredom of a humdrum life.
